versions.changelog: v2: rewritten for the WeChat 服务号 上海市级医院互联网总平台 (the standalone 上海医联 app is out of service) — 便民服务 entry, hospital/department/date-slot selection, the SMS verification gate, FLAG_SECURE traps, and book_helper.py. Setup installs the shared OCR venv from the base skill's pinned requirements-adb.txt.

Addresses ClawHub review finding on 2.0.0 (unconditional submit). 'submit' now REQUIRES --confirm, whose value must contain the hospital, department, date and 上午/下午 OCR'd off the live 预约信息 page - an agent cannot reach submission without reading the page and showing it to the user. Adds tests for the gate. Also documents the locked-keyguard cause of blank captures.

Rewrite for the WeChat 服务号 上海市级医院互联网总平台 (上海医联 app retired). Verified end-to-end 2026-10-14: real 华山医院 皮肤科 普通门诊 booking. Adds book_helper.py; documents the FLAG_SECURE blank-screenshot trap, keyboard-reflow coordinates, BACK-navigates hazard, SMS verification gate, and the 就诊卡-binding precondition.

hospital-android-adb 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automates full doctor appointment booking flow on the 医联 (Yilian) Android app using uiautomator2 only.
- Supports hospital search (Chinese input via set_text), department selection, schedule selection, and confirmation without Appium.
- Handles Chinese text input limitations and clickable parent detection in native Android layouts.
- Provides helpers for XML parsing of UI hierarchy and fallback OCR-based screen reading.
- Documents precise UI element access, technical constraints, and key implementation tips for robust automation.
